feature_description: The ritual element - agent, patient, or instrument - most directly associated with a supernatural entity. Every ritual action has three elements: 1. an agent, performing the action; 2. a patient, on which the action is being performed; 3. an instrument which is used to perform the act. When two elements are connected in some way with the supernatual, the element that is closest to it is the one which needs fewer ritual procedures to attain its association with the supernatural.
